research_question: Can a frozen symbolic receiver preserve independently measured helium-I and helium-II phase evidence on a source-separated experiment holdout?
timing: Document frozen after examining MAT-SPEC-001 through MAT-SPEC-008 data; not a retrospective preregistration for prior experiments
source_separation_unit: original independent acquisition campaign; never split records within a campaign
partition: explicit TRAIN or HOLDOUT; two families, one campaign minimum in each; both phases per partition
admissible_observable: HE4_SVP heat_capacity J_PER_MOL_K; positive calibrated per-row uncertainties; independent non-temperature phase diagnostics with distinct source SHA
receiver: Fraction-preserving authored symbolic 5 Hz per J/(mol K), quantize only after exact mapping; scale fixed before training and never tuned on holdout
metrics: reserved: predeclared source-family-separated confusion matrix and discrimination with uncertainty, only after physical admission; no scores in this release
synthetic_policy: negative controls only; all synthetic fixtures are explicitly rejected as physical data, never included as empirical accuracy
prospective_registration: future external registered receipt must be independently verified, a candidate SHA alone never certifies preregistration
output_policy: canonical ASCII JSON and CSV; no sampled waveform PCM WAV or playback
program_stop: MAT-SPEC-010 is final; SPARK/Ada and VANILLAJS Lean-ECMA afterwards
